exposure: a policy to deliver at 39 weeks for class III obesity
cohort: 1,210 women with class III obesity delivering at ≥ 37 weeks
finding: A policy of delivery at 39 weeks for class III obesity did not affect overall cesarean rate or rates of maternal or neonatal morbidity.
mod_finding: In adjusted comparisons of women undergoing labor induction, parous women had lower cesarean rates but nulliparous women had higher cesarean rates after the policy.
